title.zh: 将伊莎贝拉省划为两个公路工程区的法案
title.en: An Act Constituting the Province of Isabela into Two Highway Engineering Districts
title.orig: An Act Constituting the Province of Isabela into Two Highway Engineering Districts

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1970/ra_6149_1970.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Any provision of the law to the contrary notwithstanding, the Province of Isabela is hereby constituted into two highway engineering districts. The first highway engineering district shall comprise the municipalities of San Pablo, Cabangan, Magsaysay, Sto. Tomas, Tumauini, Ilagan, Naguilian, Benito Soliven, San Mariano, Palanan, Gamu, Burgos, Roxas, Quirino, San Manuel, Aurora, Mallig, Quezon and Sta. Maria with main office in the Municipality of Ilagan, and the second highway engineering district shall comprise the municipalities of Reina Mercedes, Cauayan, Luna, Cabanatuan, San Mateo, Ramon, Santiago, Cordon, Echague, San Isidro, Jones, San Agustin, Alicia, Angadanan, and San Guillermo with main office at the Municipality of Cauayan.
Each of the two highway engineering districts shall have one highway district engineer and necessary personnel who shall be appointed in accordance with existing laws and regulations.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: November 9, 1970.
